items.title: Two matchings with equal characteristic value admit representatives meeting exactly in the certificates
items.author: Gilad Chase; Neta Dafni; Yuval Filmus; Nathan Lindzey
items.work: Uniqueness for 2-Intersecting Families of Permutations and Perfect Matchings
items.difficulty_reason: Counted unit is the author's labelled lemma at source lines 475-477, the matching analogue of the permutation result: for a 2-intersecting family of perfect matchings whose common certificate size is at most n minus two, two members with equal characteristic value admit representatives whose certificates meet exactly in the intersection of the original certificates. The proof (source lines 478-486) writes down the representative explicitly: it lists the pairs of the first certificate, collects the indices left free, and pairs them with a fixed shift, the shifted partner of an index being separated from it by at least the two pairs that the size bound leaves free, so that the new pairs cannot meet the second certificate. The statement records the existence of the representatives and neither the listing nor the shift argument.

proof_spans.label: the complete author proof of the labelled lemma, retained line for line
